text:
```artifact
Feature: Doctor's Consultation and Prescription Process

  Scenario Outline: Doctor views and manages appointments and consultations

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When viewing pending appointments
    Then the doctor should see a list of consultations

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When viewing completed appointments
    Then the doctor should not see any pending consultations

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When viewing appointments with no status
    Then the doctor should see no appointments

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing consultation
    Then the consultation should be recorded

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing lab tests
    Then the lab tests should be recorded

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing medicines
    Then the medicines should be recorded

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When requesting lab tests delivery
    Then the lab tests delivery should be recorded

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When updating lab test reports
    Then the lab test reports should be updated

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When releasing lab test reports
    Then the lab test reports should be released

  Examples:
    | Status       | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Pending      | Consultation list is displayed                      |
    | Completed    | No pending consultations are displayed               |
    | Invalid Status| No appointments are displayed                      |
    | Prescribed   | Consultation is recorded                           |
    | Not Prescribed| Consultation is not recorded                     |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor prescribes lab tests and medicines

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing lab tests
    Then the lab tests should be created
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing medicines
    Then the medicines should be created

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When requesting lab tests delivery
    Then the lab tests delivery should be requested
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When updating lab test reports
    Then the lab test reports should be updated
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When releasing lab test reports
    Then the lab test reports should be released

  Examples:
    | Test Type | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Lab Test   | Lab tests are created and recorded                   |
    | Medicines  | Medicines are created and recorded                   |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor performs lab tests and medicines delivery

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When performing lab tests
    Then the lab tests should be performed
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When performing medicines delivery
    Then the medicines should be delivered

  Examples:
    | Test Type | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Lab Test   | Lab tests are performed                             |
    | Medicines  | Medicines are delivered                             |

```
